{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm since we are analyzing flipper length
# This ensures we only use complete cases for the mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order to find the highest
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Extract the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species_sorted.iloc[0]['species']

# Print results
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted, highest_mean_species"}
